verdict.rationale: Wyoming SOS offers a public, keyless search of registered entities by Filing ID or name, returning entity details and PDFs of many filings. It also lets anyone print or validate a certificate of good standing for free. Together these let a founder confirm an entity's registered status and see filed documents. Nothing in the evidence shows tracking the progress of a submitted or pending filing, application, or case, and the probe shows filings themselves sit behind an authenticated account. Missing for 10: public tracking of pending/in-process filings and applications, explicit entity status fields in search results, independent or hands-on corroboration of the search results.
